services.name: Ski School
services.desc: Please note: if you are looking for downhill ski lessons, please contact Nordic Valley, Snowbasin, or Powder Mountain. Class registration must be completed online a minimum of 48 hours in advance. There is no same day or on-site registration. Fees for equipment rentals, if needed, or trail passes are in addition to lesson fees. Equipment (skis, boots, & poles) rentals are available for students taking lessons. If you rent equipment from us, you are welcome to use these until 3:00 pm on the day of your class. blurb: Ogden Nordic offers a Winter Yurt Camping experience in amazing North Fork Park, home to our world-class cross-country ski venue. The Aspen, Elderberry and White Fir Yurts are equipped with one bunk bed, one double bed, table, chairs and a wood stove to cook on and keep you toasty warm following a great day of winter recreation!
